thread:
jess: Ok team — need to lock the acceptance criteria for the Acme trial. They want 3 prioritized flows (inbound routing, invoice extraction, short answer bot), clear scoring, and a timeline for delivery. Also legal pushed security Qs today. Can we align?
marcus: Propose a success matrix with measurable gates + a seed dataset (30 gold examples per flow) for regression checks.
sanjay: +1. Confirm if they want dedicated capacity; pricing changes if reserved GPUs.
lisa: Security blockers: SSO (SAML), EU data residency, KMS integration, SOC2 evidence for private deploy.
nana: ana: I can own infra checklist: SSO test plan, KMS handshake test, traffic egress map. ETA: EOD Thu for first pass.
jess: Marcus, draft scoring rubric: pass/fail infra + numeric quality score per flow; include latency and cost thresholds.
marcus: Draft: 
```
Success matrix:
- Infra gates (PASS/FAIL): SSO, KMS rotation test, EU region deploy verified
- Reliability: Uptime >= 99.5% during 30-day trial
- Latency: p95 <= 350ms for short-answer; p95 <= 800ms for invoice extraction on dedicated nodes
- Quality: golden-seed avg F1/normalized score >= 0.80 per flow
- Regression gate: <= 5% drop vs baseline on golden-seed after model change
- Cost: avg inference cost per 1k tokens below trial cap
```
marcus: Example seed item: ```json
{"id":"seed-001","flow":"invoice-extract","prompt":"Extract invoice total and currency","gold":"{\"total\":12349.00,\"currency\":\"USD\"}","weight":"2"}
```
sanjay: Pricing suggestion: 30-day trial at 50% hosted rate or fixed trial credit. Dedicated quote: 1-month reserved node at 40% list + overage. Need finance sync.
jess: Add human eval: 3 annotators, majority label for pass/fail, label rubric.
marcus: Human eval rubric: Exactness (0.6), Completeness (0.3), Format (0.1). Pass threshold weighted avg >= 0.8.
lisa: Legal asks: data processing agreement, subprocessors list. Timeline for security questionnaire answers — can we commit 5 business days?
jess: Yes if security has capacity. Lisa, own questionnaire responses?
lisa: I can. Need seedset examples + infra diagram.
nana: ana: I'll upload infra diagram + traffic flow doc.
sanjay: Enterprise blocker: Acme requires PII never be written to logs. Need confirmation we can mask/omit PII in trial.
nana: ana: We can enable no-log mode for the trial cluster and set KV cache retention to 0. Need dev signoff to prevent telemetry leaks.
marcus: I'll add `no_log=true` config and a test asserting logs contain no PII tokens.
jess: Timeline draft: today agree matrix + responsibilities; +2 biz days seedset uploaded + infra diagram; +5 biz days security answers + SSO/KMS test plan; +10 biz days trial deployment + smoke tests; +30 days evaluation end + final report.
sanjay: Finance: can we get trial credit approval by EOD tomorrow?
jess: I'll ping finance. Lisa will post security timeline after seedset review.
lisa: Expect questionnaire draft by Tue morning.
marcus: We'll record per-example scores and include manual override for borderline cases.
jess: Actions: marcus -> seedset template + scoring sheet; ana -> infra diagram + no-log note; lisa -> security Qs; sanjay -> pricing + draft quote; jess -> coordinate finance/AE.
deploy-bot: deploy status: trial-cluster-stub queued (job id: 3847) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jess: Thanks. Reconvene in 48h for a short sync. :thumbsup:
